technology_name: A MULTI-BIO COATING ORTHOPEDIC IMPLANT WITH ENHANCED CELL ADHESION AND METHOD FOR PREPARING THE SAME
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional metallic orthopedic implants exhibit poor cell integration limits and suffer from weak bone bonding interfaces that lead to premature structural implant loosening.
description: An advanced manufacturing method to apply a specialized multi-bio coating composition onto orthopedic implants, enhancing epithelial cell attachment and optimizing long-term osseointegration properties.
applications: Orthopedic joint replacement components, bone fixation hardware configurations, custom dental implant coatings, and structural prosthetic interface linings.
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care
